'''Sportvereniging Zulte Waregem''' ({{IPA|nl|ˈspɔrtfəˌreːnəɣɪŋ ˈzʏltə ˈʋaːrəɣɛm}}), commonly known as '''Zulte Waregem''' or by their nickname '''Essevee''' ({{IPA|nl|ɛsəˈveː}}), is a Belgian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Waregem]], [[West Flanders]]. The club set to play in [[Belgian Pro League]] from 2025–26 after promotion from [[Challenger Pro League]] in 2024–25. Their highest finish at the highest level was second place in [[2012–13 Belgian Pro League|2012–13]]. They have won two [[Belgian Cup]]s. They qualified for the [[2006–07 UEFA Cup]], losing in the round of 32 to [[Newcastle United F.C.|Newcastle United]]. Also in the seasons 2013–14 and 2017–18 they managed to play in the Europa League group stages. On both occasions the club ended third in their group.

The club is a product of a partnership in 2001 between Zultse VV and [[K.S.V. Waregem|KSV Waregem]], a former first division regular. No merger was applied.  Zulte Waregem first reached the highest level in Belgian football by winning the [[2004–05 in Belgian football|2004–05]] [[Belgian Second Division|second division]]. The club uniforms are red and green. They play their home matches at the [[Regenboogstadion]], the former stadium of KSV Waregem."}}
